svg.title: How to Automatically Create a Table of Contents in Word: Start by Setting Heading Styles
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to Automatically Create a Table of Contents in Word:
Start by Setting Heading Styles
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-24
Apply heading styles to the lines you
want to include
Select the line you want to include in the table
of contents, then choose Heading 1 from the
Styles gallery on the Home tab.
Insert an automatic table of contents
at the beginning of the document
Place the cursor where you want to insert the
table of contents, then open Table of Contents
on the References tab.
Check missing lines in this order
① Check whether Heading 1 or Heading 2 has
actually been applied to the missing line. ②
Check whether the table of contents is automatic…
Update the table of contents after
editing the document
Update the table of contents when you change
heading text or when the body becomes longer and
page numbers shift.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
